experiments_still_blocked.all_25: No experiment reaches its frozen minimum sample and no settled labels are collected by this design mission.

markets.paired_definition: same fixture, bookmaker, combined event-odds receipt, complete h2h, bilateral totals outcome at point=2.5

payloads_retained_if_authorized: HTTP status, content type, byte length and safe headers without API key
canonical request identity with secret redacted
receipt JSON and canonical receipt SHA-256

receipt_contract.licence_invariant: licence_status must equal APPROVED before admission
receipt_contract.storage: immutable append-only raw bytes and receipts outside Git; no secret in path, payload metadata or logs
time_invariants: TARGET: target_window_id and target_window_end required; stored separately and never exposed to feature computation
LABEL: result_available_at and settlement_receipt_at are required

retention.stop_rule: Stop if the 30-day raw TTL, automated deletion, local non-synchronised boundary, or internal-only boundary cannot be enforced.

snapshot_schema.role_isolation: PREDICTOR, TARGET and LABEL snapshots have distinct identities and storage prefixes.
snapshot_schema.shared_raw_receipt_rule: One neutral raw payload may map to different roles in different experiments; role-bound snapshot IDs and feature access controls prevent within-experiment leakage. EXP006 H2 is TARGET.

stop_criteria: internal retention policy absent, invalid, or automated 30-day raw deletion fails
H12/H6 or H1 lower-bound contract not frozen
EXP010 market clock/window semantics not frozen
fixture/settlement Source 2 not selected and approved
market-level timestamps absent or not pairable
fewer than five complete h2h books on 80% of fixtures
source host is not the official the-odds-api.com domain
a secret appears in any artifact or log
success_criteria: 100% raw payloads and canonical receipts have SHA-256
available_at is never backdated and ingestion is no later than cutoff for predictors
100% fixture mappings are deterministic and unambiguous
offline replay produces byte-identical canonical projections without network
TARGET is never used as a feature
h2h and paired totals thresholds pass
market-level timestamps are present for both markets in one receipt
The Odds API credit consumption is <= 88 and quota headers reconcile exactly
zero secret is present in payload metadata, receipts, logs or repository artifacts

thresholds.h2h: at least five complete 1X2 bookmakers for at least 80% of all 18 fixtures at each required frozen window
thresholds.mapping: 100% deterministic one-to-one event mapping with kickoff/team normalization evidence
thresholds.market_timestamp: both market-level last_update values non-null for every admitted pair; provider freshness skew computed within one combined receipt
thresholds.totals: at least five same-receipt paired bookmakers with complete h2h and bilateral point=2.5 totals for at least 80% (4/5) canary fixtures at H24, H2 and H1

windows.authority_caveat: H12/H6, the strict H1 lower bound and EXP010 market-clock semantics must be frozen in an amended protocol before any activation.
